name: Low Self Esteem
overview: Scripture reveals that feelings of inadequacy and low self-esteem are common human experiences, as seen in Moses’ admission of being slow of speech and Jeremiah’s declaration of being a child unable to speak. Yet, the Bible also affirms the believer’s worth through God’s intentional and marvelous creation, as expressed in Psalms 139:14. While Isaiah acknowledges his uncleanliness before the holy God, Zephaniah reminds us that the LORD is mighty to save and rejoices over His people with love and singing. Believers are called to seek God's kingdom first, trusting that He will provide and affirm their true value.
